renderer: Microsoft Word for Mac 16.114.1, macOS 27.0.1, Apple Silicon
method: Each file opened alone with `open -a "Microsoft Word"` from a scratch folder; prompts read and answered through System Events. No recovery chosen, no preference changed, nothing saved. The control was opened before the first variant and again after the last.
operator: Claude Code driving Word through AppleScript, with the maintainer's permission; not blind to the expectations.
unrelated: On each launch an installed Adobe PDF add-in raised Visual Basic run-time error 53 (MacPDFM.framework not found); dismissed with End.
